## Overview

Arockiam et al. 2021 [@arockiam2021] simulated and built a serpentine micromixer.

## Experimental method

*"1-mM Fluorescein Isothiocyanate (FITC) solution. Experiments were conducted using two values of the overall flow rate, Q, i.e., 0.1 µL/min, and 10 µL/min...mages were captured at multiple locations along the mixing channel using an exposure time of 100 ms."*
